replies.author: Yaky
replies.body: Detail is spectacular, but the gameplay is what I don't like. The middle platform is so small and with void ruins some of the pvp when someone has the fast hit or op knockback. I liked the older cth maps that were huge and had little to no void so that you could have a decent fight with someone like forerunner or frozen or sakura's outside area. I'm just not that big of a fan of cth void maps, ruins it for me. I say make mid a bit bigger and lessen the void 0/
